question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the following sentence.

The recent strike of the employees left the factory and its machinery in disorder.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Out of gear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Need of the hour"** means something that is very much needed at the present time; it emphasizes the urgency or necessity of a situation. (वर्तमान समय में बहुत आवश्यक)
 
 
• **Example: **With the increasing pollution, planting more trees is the need of the hour.
 
 

 
• **"Out of gear" **refers to something that is not functioning properly or is in a state of disorder; it can be used literally, like machinery not working, or metaphorically, like plans going awry. (अव्यवस्थित)
 
 
• **Example: **After the power outage, the entire production line was out of gear.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate idiom to describe the factory and its machinery being in disorder due to the recent strike of the employees is **'Out of gear'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Out of gear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pin-money **(खर्च के लिए छोटी रकम): A small amount of money for spending on personal things, traditionally given to a wife by her husband.
 
 
• **Example:** She saved her pin-money to buy a new dress for the party.
 
 

 
• **Lock and key **(सुरक्षित रखना): To keep something secure and protected, often used metaphorically.
 
 
• **Example: **He keeps his documents under lock and key to prevent any unauthorized access.
